messages:
Anya: Proposal: introduce an 'ephemeral-scan' lane for infra-only PRs to reduce SAST/DAST noise and speed reviews. Plan is to issue ephemeral KMS grants for artifact decrypt, and write a single audit row linking token_id -> pr_number -> user. @Ravi @Chris could use your eyes on RBAC + logging requirements.

Ravi: Sounds promising. My chief concern is auditability: we must be able to prove who requested the token and which PR triggered it. Request: audit row should include pr_number, repo, issuer_user, token_id, purpose, and ttl_seconds. Also need a mapping to any RBAC exception ticket if one exists.

Chris: Implementation sketch: extend keystore API with issue_ephemeral(pr_number, repo, issuer, ttl, purpose) -> {token_id}. The keystore currently logs token_id + issuer, but not PR metadata. We'll add columns pr_number and repo_path to the keystore_audit table and populate on issue. Backfill plan: existing rows null for pr_number.

Infra-Automation: I put a minimal GH Action prototype in the repo to decide lanes by path globs and request the ephemeral token. Example snippet: ```yaml
on: pull_request
jobs:
  scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: select-lane
        run: ./scripts/select_lane.sh
      - name: request-keystore-token
        run: |
          curl -sS -X POST 
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.KMS_API_KEY }}" 
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
            --data '{"pr_number": "${{ github.event.number }}", "repo": "${{ github.repository }}", "purpose": "scan", "ttl": 600}' 
            https://keystore.internal/api/issue_ephemeral```

Anya: Security/Process asks: 1) RBAC change so the GH Actions service principal can call issue_ephemeral but only for repos with a feature flag (ephemeral_scan_enabled) and only when PR paths match infra/*; 2) manual override path to request full-scan; 3) retention policy for pr metadata in audit logs.

Ravi: Incident handling: if keystore is unreachable during scan request, I recommend fail-closed for infra-impacting PRs (block merge) and fail-open for low-risk (docs, readme). When fail-open or fallback is used, create an incident ticket automatically and trigger a full-scan run on the queued scanner pool. Add monitoring alert for keystore issuance errors > 5/min.

Chris: Migration notes: add pr_number (varchar), repo_path (varchar) to keystore_audit; feature-flag gate on ephemeral_scan_enabled at repo level; add index on token_id+pr_number for fast lookup. Retention: security/legal asks for 365d for audit retention; app team prefers 180d. I'll flag for legal review. Also need a small RBAC adjustment doc describing least-privilege scopes for the Actions principal.

sec-bot: RBAC request created REQ-2026-799 by Anya. Runbook stub: https://go/internal/runbooks/ephemeral-scan. Audit fields requested: token_id, pr_number, repo, issuer_user, ttl_seconds, issued_at.

Anya: I'll draft an RFC and attach a short runbook + RBAC request. Pilot: enable ephemeral-scan for infra/* in repo infra-config for two weeks, with monitoring and manual rollback. Will include canary rules: if changed files > 25 or new ports/protocols touched, automatically escalate to full-scan.

Ravi: +1 on pilot and rollback rules. Please include telemetry events for how often ephemeral tokens are used vs. fallbacks.

Chris: I'll open the keystore PR and migration, mark it behind feature flag. Ping me for pairing on flow tests.

Anya: Thanks all 680
